primary_gt.computed_interpretation: Wind and pressure extrema form a late-window pulse; hourly rainfall peaks are offset from that pulse.

key_values.event_name: Hurricane Ophelia impacts in Ireland and the UK

criteria.name: Final ledger and label
criteria.description: Returns the requested compact JSON and labels the result late_wind_pressure_pulse_with_offset_rain_peaks.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for an equivalent label with incomplete JSON; no credit for a broad narrative without the ledger.

criteria.name: Peak values and units
criteria.description: Reports 111.6 km/h gust, 61.4 km/h 10 m wind, 989.6 hPa minimum pressure, 13.1 mm total point rainfall, and 0.9 mm hourly rainfall peak.
criteria.partial_credit: Award roughly 0.8 points per correct value; cap at 3 points if units or rounding are unclear.

criteria.name: Peak times and rainfall tie handling
criteria.description: Reports gust and wind at 2017-10-16T14:00, pressure at 2017-10-16T15:00, and both rainfall-peak times.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for correct wind-pressure times but only one rainfall-peak time; award 1 point for a partly correct time list.

criteria.name: Timing arithmetic
criteria.description: Computes same-hour wind/gust as true, pressure lag as 1 hour, nearest rainfall-peak lag as 22 hours before gust, earliest rainfall-peak lag as 127 hours before gust, and 0.4 mm within the 3-hour gust window.
criteria.partial_credit: Award credit for each correct timing test; reduce credit for wrong sign conventions.

criteria.name: Event-window source discipline
criteria.description: Derives the peak ledger from the event-window hourly point-weather arrays and does not score or substitute separate daily cross-check values.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point if the hourly extrema are mostly correct but the proof mixes in unrequested daily summaries.

criteria.name: Concise computed interpretation
criteria.description: States that the wind-pressure extrema form a late-window pulse and rainfall peaks are offset, without adding loss totals, public guidance, or broad event narration.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for the right conclusion with extra unneeded prose.
